description: libsodium call surface. Prefix families cover the per-primitive namespaces (crypto_secretbox*, crypto_box*, crypto_sign*, crypto_auth*, crypto_pwhash*, crypto_generichash*, crypto_hash_*) and the randombytes* RNG surface. The AEAD namespace is claimed via its algorithm-qualified prefixes (crypto_aead_chacha20poly1305_*, crypto_aead_xchacha20poly1305_*) so it never collides with the kernel's bare crypto_aead_<verb> names; new libsodium AEAD algorithms (aes256gcm, aegis...) are new prefixes here, not code edits.
